headline: China sentences Evergrande real estate giant founder to life imprisonment | CR Hoy
summary: A Chinese court sentenced Xu Jiayin, founder of Evergrande, to life imprisonment for crimes including large-scale financial fraud. The group was fined more than US$2 billion.
why: Evergrande was one of China's largest property developers, and its collapse became a central case in the country's real estate debt crisis.
